name: Sterling Tools Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, Sterling Tools Ltd manufactures Fasteners & MCUs[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
STL manufactures cold forged, hi-tensile fasteners and supplies to all major auto OEMs across PVs, CVs, 2Ws, Construction and Farm Equipment segments

pros: Debtor days have improved from 32.3 to 23.3 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 36.7 days to 24.6 days
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 12.3% over last 3 years.
